title: The Salt Road
description: A lighthouse keeper keeps a light for a ship that may never come.
outline:
1. Mara keeps the light through a storm.
2. A door under the stairs opens onto a colder shore.
3. The ship answers.

beginning.overview: Mara keeps the light and counts the ships that do not come.
beginning.keyMoments: The storm arrives; the lamp will not turn.

middle.overview: A door under the stairs opens onto a shore that should not be there.
middle.keyMoments: Mara steps through and finds the keeper's log from a future year.
middle.openQuestions: Is the other shore a memory or a warning?

end.overview: The ship answers the light, and Mara chooses what to keep.
end.keyMoments: The lamp turns; the door closes.
end.openQuestions: What does she leave on the other shore?

characters.name: Mara Venn
characters.description: Practical, salt-weathered, keeps a ledger of every ship she has not seen.
characters.motivations: Keep the light turning and finish her father's log.
characters.notes: Left-handed. Wears a red wool hat.

memories.text: The lamp turns clockwise; the door under the stairs opens the other way.
